content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect configuration of the pinmux settings for a pin controlled by the iomuxc-snvs pin controller. The pin was originally specified under the general iomuxc node instead of the specific iomuxc-snvs node, leading to improper pin functionality. This patch corrects the pin assignment by moving the pin definition to the appropriate iomuxc-snvs node and updating the pinctrl-0 reference accordingly.
